layout.desktop_split: 72% hero / 28% login approximately; follow final reference rather than hard-coding if viewport changes
layout.mobile_behavior: stack login and hero; keep cards horizontally scrollable or 2-column/1-column based on width; never distort logos

typography.rule: Do not recreate typography inside logo assets. Treat logo lockups as immutable raster assets.
typography.ui: Use a clean sans-serif for functional UI; preserve the visual hierarchy of the approved cover.
